event.text: I recommend a Counsel clinician review in this thread during today's service hours to plan which STI tests fit your situation and how samples are collected (urine, swab, or blood). Screening is worthwhile even without symptoms, since many STIs cause none. If you develop genital sores, unusual discharge, painful urination, fever, or pelvic/abdominal pain, contact a clinician promptly rather than waiting for that review.
